question: The population of a district is 340000, out of which 217000 are males. 11% of the population is literate. If 11% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the concept of weighted average or mixtures:

If the overall percentage of a quantity is 11%, and one part of it is also exactly 11%, then the remaining part must also be exactly 11%.

Since overall literacy is 11% and male literacy is 11%, female literacy will directly be 11% irrespective of the population distribution.

**∴ The correct answer is 11%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total population = 340000

Males = 217000

Literate population = 11%

Literate
